scientific_integrity: The exact symbolic decomposition is the proof. Finite exact-characteristic-polynomial checks at five small sizes are corroboration, not proof for arbitrary sizes.
scientific_limitations: Only two hard-core bosons, ideal uniform real hopping on friendship graphs with at least three triangles; no field, disorder, higher occupancy or dynamical transfer bounds. Historical-priority search is nonexhaustive.
title: Exact two-hard-core-boson spectrum and localized flat levels on friendship quantum networks
